evidence.detail: The class extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and builds exact root widget 60200. Its root title literal is '@or1@Donation Shopping Cart' and its primary background is exact asset 'misc/cart 0'.

The interface contains Shopping Cart, subtotal, Empty, Checkout, PayPal (Card / Bank), OSRS GP, Daily Offer, Exclusive Offers and purchase-option presentation controls, fixing the screen as the donation checkout/cart surface.

The builder owns the exact offer and purchase-state widget ranges around 60064..60088/60262, including daily/exclusive offer text, cart subtotal text and checkout button variants driven by interface-script comparison arrays.
Outside its own class, exact v308 references rs/n/c/aw only from R436 CustomInterfaceRegistry and rs/q/a/a/b. No unrelated interface family or gameplay domain owns the builder.
The class constructs client-side donation/cart presentation only. No payment processing, purchase fulfilment or server-side commerce authority is inferred from this interface builder.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 descriptive name from the screen's own Donation Shopping Cart title, checkout/payment-option controls and dedicated cart resources. No server-side payment semantics are claimed.
